timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,336–1,340 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently strong (low KRW per USD), making dollars expensive for your monthly conversion. News reports indicate the won is "reviving" and the dollar is "faltering," with the rate expected to remain in the 1,340 early-mid range due to geopolitical risk-off sentiment. However, brokerage analysts project the rate could fall further to the 1,200s, suggesting the won may strengthen even more.

TIP: Consider waiting for a weaker won (higher KRW/USD rate like 1,350+) if your budget allows, or dollar-cost average smaller amounts monthly to reduce timing risk on a fixed obligation.
